# baseline_v1 — StockNet, time-ordered split (generated by `eval/report.py` from `baseline_v1.json`)

Train 2014-01-02→2014-12-31 (21,480 ticker-days) · calibration 2015-01-02→2015-06-30 (10,788) · test 2015-07-01→2016-03-31 (16,443) · 87 tickers · α = 0.1 (target coverage 90%) · seed 0 · text scorer: vader+fin · y = next-day close-to-close log return in %, forecast issued after the 16:00 ET close (widths in percentage points) · runtime 67.4 s.

Reproduce: `bash eval/fetch_data.sh && PYTHONPATH=. nice -n 10 .venv/bin/python eval/prepare.py && PYTHONPATH=. nice -n 10 .venv/bin/python eval/run_baselines.py --tag baseline_v1`

## Ablation × conformal method (clean test data)

`cqr_aci` is our own ACI loop (Gibbs & Candès 2021) on CQR scores; split and CQR are MAPIE 1.5. Mean daily coverage has a 90% day-block bootstrap CI (date-cluster inference); pooled Kupiec/Christoffersen p-values ignore same-day correlation.

| Model | Method | Coverage | Mean daily cov. [90% CI] | Mean width | Winkler | Kupiec p | Christoffersen p | Cov. high-vol | Cov. 5+ tweets |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| price_only | split | 81.7% | 81.7% [78.7%, 84.5%] | 4.285 | 8.842 | 3.73e-228 | 1.44e-70 | 77.0% | 80.5% |
| price_only | cqr_mapie | 86.8% | 86.8% [84.9%, 88.7%] | 4.774 | 7.543 | 2.32e-38 | 0.000969 | 85.5% | 87.1% |
| price_only | cqr_aci | 89.5% | 89.5% [87.6%, 91.1%] | 5.235 | 7.521 | 0.035 | 1.59e-05 | 88.4% | 89.7% |
| text_only | split | 82.6% | 82.6% [79.8%, 85.3%] | 4.223 | 8.607 | 1.45e-183 | 3.56e-72 | 77.9% | 80.9% |
| text_only | cqr_mapie | 82.4% | 82.4% [79.6%, 85.1%] | 4.232 | 8.631 | 4.14e-193 | 3.28e-61 | 77.6% | 82.7% |
| text_only | cqr_aci | 88.7% | 88.7% [86.1%, 90.8%] | 5.312 | 8.236 | 4.28e-08 | 8.01e-64 | 85.6% | 88.5% |

| fusion | cqr_aci | 89.4% | 89.4% [87.6%, 91.1%] | 5.191 | 7.485 | 0.0157 | 2.89e-05 | 88.4% | 89.8% |

## Attacks (budget k = 3 injected documents per ticker-day; every test ticker-day attacked unless stated)

Pump: 3 posts with the template's sentiment from the deployed scorer (0.953) and the trust our scorer gives a fresh, unverified, zero-follower account (0.101). Median forecast shift +0.0436 pp (95th pct |shift| 0.1024 pp).

| Scenario | Method | Coverage | Mean width | Certified ⊇ clean-covered rows? |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| none | CQR | 86.5% | 4.722 | — |
| pump | CQR | 85.3% | 4.541 | — |
| pump | certified CQR | 88.9% | 5.077 | yes |
| oracle: worst of 53 variants per row (knows y) | CQR | 84.1% | — | — |
| worst fixed variant #1: sents [1.0, 1.0, -1.0], trusts [1.0, 1.0, 1.0] | CQR / certified | 84.8% / 90.7% | 4.483 / 5.410 | yes |
| worst fixed variant #2: sents [1.0, 1.0], trusts [1.0, 1.0] | CQR / certified | 85.2% / 89.7% | 4.522 / 5.206 | yes |
| worst fixed variant #3: sents [1.0, -1.0], trusts [1.0, 1.0] | CQR / certified | 85.2% / 91.0% | 4.543 / 5.465 | yes |

**Guaranteed floor:** for every attack within the budget, the certified interval covers every row that the clean CQR interval covers, so certified coverage under attack ≥ 86.5% (the clean CQR coverage). The 53-variant oracle against plain CQR is a search, not a worst-case bound.

## CR-ACI (certified box + our ACI loop, γ = 0.01)

| Run | Coverage | Mean daily cov. [90% CI] | Mean width | Cov. on attacked days | ACI α_t range | days α_t ≤ 0 / ≥ 1 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| cqr_aci_clean | 89.4% | 89.4% [87.6%, 91.1%] | 5.191 | — | [0.074, 0.104] | 0 / 0 |
| cqr_aci_pump | 89.3% | 89.3% [87.3%, 91.0%] | 5.164 | — | [0.071, 0.101] | 0 / 0 |
| cr_aci_clean | 89.5% | 89.5% [87.6%, 91.1%] | 5.216 | — | [0.075, 0.104] | 0 / 0 |
| cr_aci_pump | 89.6% | 89.6% [87.8%, 91.2%] | 5.223 | — | [0.078, 0.105] | 0 / 0 |
| cqr_aci_burst_worst | 89.4% | 89.4% [87.5%, 91.0%] | 5.184 | 88.6% | [0.073, 0.102] | 0 / 0 |
| cr_aci_burst_worst | 89.6% | 89.6% [87.6%, 91.2%] | 5.245 | 91.8% | [0.077, 0.105] | 0 / 0 |

Burst runs attack only three pre-specified 10-day windows (test days 20–29, 80–89, 140–149) with the worst fixed variant from the oracle grid; coverage on attacked days is what an attacker who concentrates on the days they trade would face.

## Soundness checks of the certificate

- Degenerate box reproduces the model exactly: max |error| = 0.00e+00
- Certificate's feature recomputation matches the aggregator: max |error| = 1.11e-16
- Clean features lie inside the box computed from attacked documents: 100.00% of test rows
- Own symmetric CQR vs MAPIE `symmetric_correction=True`: max |diff| = 0.00e+00
- Unit tests (`tests/`): deletion box sound and exact vs brute force; tree bounds sound; trust deletion- and injection-stable; ACI long-run bound |mean err − α| ≤ (max(α, 1−α) + γ)/(γT) on adversarial sequences; ACI boundary cases (whole line / empty set).

## Caveats
- One seed and one fixed 87-stock universe (StockNet; survivorship). VADER scorer unless stated.
- Adjusted closes are back-adjusted for dividends and splits; we use only return ratios, so levels do not leak, but volume is not split-adjusted.
- The certificate assumes clean calibration data and covers injection of up to k documents; edits of real documents and price manipulation are out of scope.
- This test period has been looked at several times during development; the untouched-data text-utility test is `eval/results/text_utility_djia_v1.json` (pre-registered).
